policy.statement: J-space is the Phase 5 active-loop diagnostic because it is cheap, item-level, and directly actionable. It is evidence for choosing a lever, never a primary objective, gate threshold, or score to optimize.
policy.sealed_test_exclusion: Sealed test paths (eval_freeform/test.jsonl) are never read for fitting, annotation, routing, or stream selection; jspace_annotator.py refuses them by denylist.
policy.sae_deferral: SAE is deferred, not deleted: it becomes relevant only after the loop plateaus, J-space signals are ambiguous, or a compatible low-cost Qwen3-0.6B SAE exists. SAE is not a first-pass autoresearch lever.
